summary: Bumped go.mod 'go' directive and toolchain to go1.26.5.
reason: GO-2026-5856 (crypto/tls) is reachable from the generated client and MCP server when built with go1.26.4; fixed in the go1.26.5 stdlib. The public library's supply-chain gate also enforces a repo-wide go-directive floor of 1.26.5.
validated_outcome: govulncheck ./... reports no vulnerabilities after the bump.
